definitions.standalone_e2e_pass: Live acquisition through parsed normalized output for the stated bounded sample; no Codex runtime required.
definitions.standalone_partial: A material acquisition or parsing limitation remains; read the row before running at scale.
definitions.publisher_download: Separate native-export transport outcome; passed does not mean a whole jurisdiction or current edition.
definitions.complete_corpus: All publications, amendments, attachments and parsing completeness verified; never inferred from a sample.
